new.title: New
new.double: From 2:00 powder fills twice as fast. Time to push!
new.overtime: Crowns are even — the deciding minute. The first new crown takes the battle.
tut.1.place: Drag the cannon to the framed cell. You can only build in your zone — the dashed outline.
tut.1.shoot: The cannon fires on its own at the nearest enemy in range. Finish the tower!
tut.1.next: A fallen tower is a crown. Next: pushing your frontline.
tut.2.walls: Every building grows your zone. Put walls forward until one stands on the enemy half.
tut.2.next: The further your frontline, the closer your guns get to the enemy. One more thing.
tut.3.place: Place a cannon. Powder fills by itself — watch the bar under the field.
tut.3.stack: Drop a second cannon right onto the first: it gets a star — stronger and like new.
tut.all: Training done. Take your first chest — and into battle.
